answer: Liveness escrow with island verification: each identity must answer a random, time-boxed challenge routed through a distinct network island (independent ASN). Clones sharing infrastructure fail or time out, and the escrow is forfeited to the challenger. The per-identity cost is a locked deposit plus recurring challenge compute, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV. A hollow agent economy cannot subsidize duplicate answers, while an orchard of genuine operators earns escrow back.
